ns2:section.sectionText: <<Section restricted to MSPE graduate students>> Graduate credit requires an additional paper or project beyond the undergraduate requirements for this course. Contact instructor for details.**This course develops analytical tools to employ economic modeling and data to make better strategic decisions. The objective of this course is to foster data-driven critical-thinking skills through econometric analyses and statistical interpretation.**
